status: CANDIDATES for the art director; not imported (the hero swing clip; heroes have only idle and walk today)
name: S1 knight v3: its own sword (and shield)
layout: <facing>.png = the object's rotation (frame 0 still); attack/<facing>/0..N.png = the kept roll; alt/<roll>/attack/<facing>/ = refused rolls
tool: animate_object v3 on the outfit object, frame_count 6, keep_first_frame TRUE (7 stored frames, frame 0 the rotation = the still, checked byte for byte); one group per action text

r1.action: raises the sword and cuts down and forward in one short swing, then brings it back to its stance, the shield stays on the other arm, feet planted, the sword stays in its hand the whole time, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

r2.action: seen from the side, raises the sword and cuts down and forward in one short swing toward the side it faces, then brings it back to its stance, it never turns toward the viewer, the shield stays on the other arm, feet planted, the sword stays in its hand the whole time, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

r3.action: stays in profile facing right the whole time, lifts the sword up in front of it and cuts it down in front, then lowers it back to where it started, the shield stays on its arm, feet planted, the sword stays in its hand the whole time, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

b2.directions: n w se sw ne nw
b2.action: keeps facing the same way the whole time, raises the sword and cuts down in one short swing toward the way it faces, then lowers it back to where it started, the shield stays on its arm, feet planted, the sword stays in its hand the whole time, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

b2r2.action: seen from behind the whole time and never turning around, raises the sword and cuts down in one short swing away from the viewer, then lowers it back to where it started, the shield stays on its arm, feet planted, the sword stays in its hand the whole time, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

b2r3.action: seen from behind the whole time and never turning around, raises the steel sword and cuts down in one short swing away from the viewer, then lowers it back to where it started, the red plume stays on the helmet, the shield stays on its arm, feet planted, the sword stays steel grey and in its hand the whole time, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

refused.east r1: turns to face the viewer at frames 3-6 (the shield comes round)
refused.east r2: turns its back at frames 4-6, the sword barely swings
refused.north-west b2: the plume comes off as a red blob by the sword (frames 3-6)
refused.north-west b2r2: a red streak by the sword again (frames 4-6)

measured.how: each kept frame against the rotation of its facing: xor = mask px changed, alien = px with no colour within 60 RGB of the still inside 3 px (a flash or a new colour), dx/dy = centroid shift px, top/bottom = box edge change px (negative = up)

flags: south-east: the body turns a little at frames 4-5 mid-swing, then back
south r1 ends with the sword across the body (frame 6 is not quite the still)
